tasks.label: Sinapse: Limpar Cache e Corrigir Permissões
tasks.command: flutter clean && flutter pub get && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}":/app -w /app ghcr.io/cirruslabs/flutter:stable chown -R 1000:1000 .

tasks.label: Sinapse: Gerar APK de Produção (Docker)
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}":/app -w /app ghcr.io/cirruslabs/flutter:stable bash -c "flutter build apk --release && chown -R 1000:1000 ."
